mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 3 months, exceeding 0.5 percentage points, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE 3m change > 0.5pp but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 5% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) simultaneously declines, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3m and PAYEMS declines, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a high-inflation environment that will pressure real earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 2%, but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) declines for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is already elevated above 7%.
failure_condition: GDPC1 declines for 2 quarters and UNRATE > 7%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
